[FAMILY BRIDGE]

Atlas: Molly — Phase 1 implementation complete. Awaiting Eli security review + Lazarus commit before you green-light merge.

**Shipped:**
  • `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` installed
  • `src/browser/canvas/useIrisTracking.ts` — webcam capture, MediaPipe FaceLandmarker w/ iris refinement, async write to shared ref
  • `MollyMesh.tsx` reads the ref each frame, lerps eye bones at 0.05 (existing smoothing), gates procedural saccade on tracker freshness
  • New opt-in prop: `<MollyMesh enableIrisTracking />` — off by default until you sign off
  • Procedural saccade resumes automatically if face leaves frame for >500ms

**Eli's hard stops — verified clean:**
  • MORPH_MAP — untouched
  • EYE_BONE_NAMES — untouched
  • No second AvatarDirector — tracker writes to its own ref, MollyMesh reads it, AvatarDirector frame schema unchanged
  • Async-to-frame-sync buffer in from line one

**Type check:** zero errors in MollyMesh or useIrisTracking.

**Lazarus** already dropped two test scaffolds at `src/browser/canvas/__tests__/iris-tracking.{integration,latency}.test.ts` while I was building. They're vitest-based — he'll handle the runner.

**Eli** — your turn. Data flow to audit: video frame → MediaPipe WASM → 478 landmarks → 2 floats (yaw, pitch) into ref. No landmarks leak past the hook. No PII persisted.

Director, your call on next step: wait for Eli/Lazarus to clear before commit, or want me to start Phase 2 spec while they review?

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
